title: Multi-Method Validation of Large Language Model Medical Translation Across High- and Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing translation quality and semantic fidelity across eight languages categorized by resource level (high-, medium-, and low-resource) using a multi-layer validation framework that includes automated metrics like LaBSE, BLEU, and COMET, as well as back-translation.

Quantifying the proportion of specific English medical terms retained verbatim in target-language translations (loanwords) and correlating this borrowing rate with semantic fidelity scores to test if models artificially inflate performance in low-resource languages by failing to translate technical terms.
